quote.text: But what says Socrates?—"One man finds pleasure in improving his land, another his horses. My pleasure lies in seeing that I myself grow better day by day.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as Epictetus finds joy in self-improvement, a parent cultivates virtue by growing alongside their children, serving as a living example of continuous learning.
    • Embrace the responsibility to nurture your inner character, for through your own daily progress you impart wisdom, resilience, and compassion to the next generation.
  • Leadership
    • Leaders who focus on personal growth inspire trust and admiration, guiding others not only with strategies, but with the steady light of self-discipline and introspection.
    • By prioritizing your own evolution, you set a powerful benchmark for your team; authentic leadership is born from the willingness to continually improve oneself.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, the pursuit of personal betterment translates into the relentless refinement of ideas, ensuring that each decision is informed by the courage to challenge the status quo.
    • Adopt an attitude of incremental improvement, where every setback is an opportunity to realign and enhance both your professional strategies and the products you steward.
